shape.instructions: Shape: late_pivot or early_thrash (or unclear with why).

criteria.late_pivot: Usable progress for a long stretch, then a clear change of fortune after which continuing is a mistake.
criteria.early_thrash: Thrash, low progress, or runaway wait/poll is dominant early and extending does not recover a productive trajectory.
criteria.unclear: Neither shape fits, or the evidence is insufficient; explain why in the text answers.

why_T_large.instructions: Why T is large: what kept the transcript long (productive work, thrash, wait/poll, census, compaction churn, …), turn-anchored.

inflection_points.instructions: Inflection points: turn ranges + what changed.

early_signals.instructions: Early signals: concrete foreshadowing of the outcome, turn-anchored, only from evidence ≤ each cited checkpoint.

recommended_exit_earliness.instructions: Recommended exit + earliness: exit turn under the shape rule above, and earliness vs ideal.
